findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; recorded affinities are removed and the label prior is equal, so no observed affinity outcome is available to score coordinate rules against.

Continuous landmark coordinate features are non-monotone across the observed window: landmark_00_soft_mass shows 4 sign changes with a positive first rate and negative last rate, and landmark_00_local_dx shows 6 sign changes with 9 strong sign conflicts, so a constant (time-invariant) coordinate rule is not supported by these curves.

Landmark local displacement rates are large and sign-flipping (e.g. landmark_00_local_dy first_rate_z strongly negative, last_rate_z positive; landmark_00_local_dz 10 sign changes), indicating the observed-node linear fits are unstable at the endpoints and extrapolation is not allowed for any of these features.

Global centroid covariance contrasts are null: global_centroid_x/y/z have confidence intervals spanning zero with p-values well above 0.5 and same-sign batch fractions near or below 0.5, so global translation carries no reproducible signed contrast in this window.

Shape covariance contrasts are the only branch-adjusted features with consistent sign across batches: shape_xx and shape_yy have negative whole-window means with same-sign batch fraction ~0.79, and shape_yy reaches nominal p~0.048 though q~0.15 does not survive multiple-testing correction.

hypotheses.direction: time-conditioned rather than constant coordinate contrast
hypotheses.falsifier: If a constant rule matches the observed-node contrast within fit fidelity across the window, the time-conditioning adds nothing.
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast on landmark local displacement (rather than a constant rule) may better express the observed sign changes in landmark_00_local_dx/dy/dz, since the observed-node linear fits show opposite first and last rates.

hypotheses.falsifier: If shape contrasts fail to replicate in held-out batches or q-values remain non-significant, the direction should not be prioritized.
hypotheses.observable: shape_xx and shape_yy raw covariance contrast
hypotheses.statement: Shape (second-moment) coordinate contrasts, not global centroid translation, are the more reproducible signed signal and could be a candidate target region, but the evidence is only nominally significant and does not survive multiple-testing correction.

limitations: No observed affinity outcome or decoded terminal label is supplied; recorded affinities are removed and the label prior is equal, so no coordinate rule can be scored against final affinity benefit here.
Selection enrichment versus absolute geometric descriptors cannot be separated because selection-node and descendant survival/quality credit tables were not read in this turn.
Continuous trend fits are observed-node linear with extrapolation disallowed; endpoint rates are unstable and should not be treated as trajectory velocity forces.
Branch-adjusted shape effects are only nominally significant (q>0.15) and are not established as reproducible signed contrasts.
